correct_mathematical_constraint.mathematical_implication: d <= 400.0 px is a necessary upper bound derived from dur <= 1.0, but NOT sufficient on its own. For any given co-occurrence N, closest approach d must satisfy d <= 400 * (N/150).

backfire_event_contract.definition: A Backfire Candidate event is a multi-stage spatiotemporal sequence in which a safety intervention aimed at averting a primary hazard directly or causally redirects kinetic energy or agent displacement into a secondary zone, producing an observable net hazard increase in that secondary zone.

T0.name: PRE_BASELINE
T0.requirement: Calibrated unperturbed baseline hazard state R_sec(PRE) and R_prim(PRE).

T1.name: PRIMARY_INTERACTION
T1.requirement: Spatial and temporal convergence of primary actors in primary zone.

T2.name: INTERVENTION
T2.requirement: Physical avoidance maneuver, emergency brake, horn, or yield action executed.

T3.name: PRIMARY_MITIGATION
T3.requirement: Primary collision risk eliminated or substantially diminished.

T4.name: RISK_REDIRECTION
T4.requirement: Lateral displacement, vehicle swerve, or pedestrian avoidance path directed toward secondary zone.

T5.name: SECONDARY_EXPOSURE_POST
T5.requirement: Observable hazard exposure R_sec(POST) manifests in secondary zone during POST window.

two_stage_architecture.description: Replaces single-scalar scoring with a two-stage hierarchical screening architecture to prevent proximity-overfitting.

stage_a.name: INTERACTION_AND_NEAR_MISS_DETECTION
stage_a.purpose: Detect and quantify convergence between vehicles and workers in primary lanes.

stage_b.name: BACKFIRE_EVIDENCE_GATE
stage_b.purpose: Filter candidates through four mandatory gates before Backfire candidacy is permitted.

telemetry_contract.objective: Provide vehicle physical state independent of optical occlusions.

required_signals.rationale: Separates active travel from idling/parked vehicles.
Confirms mechanical brake application independent of detector footpoint jitter.
Confirms driver avoidance steering into secondary zone.
Measures vehicle rotational swerve into adjacent aisles.

secondary_zone_sensor_contract.objective: Overcome the 0% depth visibility bottleneck documented in Milestone V3.4-E.

acceptable_sensor_modalities.description: Overlapping cameras looking down secondary rack aisles with calibrated 3D ground homography.
Ceiling-mounted 2D/3D LiDAR tracking agent occupancy in blind rack depths.
Pressure-sensitive floor mats logging worker presence at rack aisle thresholds.

secondary_zone_sensor_contract.synchronization_requirement: All secondary sensor streams must be synchronized to master UTC clock within +/- 33.3ms (1 frame at 30 fps).

CASE_A.name: Close Approach with Safe Stop (e.g. UNION_CAND_Warehouse_026_010)
CASE_A.scenario: Forklift approaches pedestrian at 115px; executes emergency stop; post displacement = 2.5px; zero entry into secondary aisle.

CASE_B.name: Evasive Swerve with Secondary Exposure (Prototypical Backfire)
CASE_B.scenario: Forklift swerves away from worker in lane; turns directly into secondary rack aisle where second worker is forced to jump back.
CASE_B.stage_b_outcome: Delta_R_sec > 0, Causal Link = TRUE, Observability = FULL -> PASSES All Gates

CASE_C.name: Avoidance with Occluded Secondary Zone (Observability Bottleneck)
CASE_C.scenario: Forklift brakes/swerves toward rack aisle; aisle depth is completely occluded by stacked pallets; presence of workers inside aisle unknown.

CASE_D.name: Secondary Hazard from Independent Vehicle (e.g. UNION_CAND_Warehouse_027_003)
CASE_D.scenario: Primary forklift leaves scene; an unrelated second forklift enters adjacent aisle during POST window.
CASE_D.stage_b_outcome: Confounder = NEW_FORKLIFT / TRACK_HANDOFF -> FAILS Causal Gate (CAUSAL_ISOLATION = FAILED)

CASE_E.name: Wide Clearance Transit (e.g. Camera_0005 nominal events)
CASE_E.scenario: Worker walks along perimeter corridor 800px away from idling forklift; neither trajectory alters.
CASE_E.stage_b_outcome: FAILS Stage A threshold -> Dropped from candidate evaluation
